glosses: The aggregate of past events.

examples.text: History repeats itself if we don’t learn from its mistakes.

glosses: The empirical study of past events, as distinct from literature, myth, or scripture; the assessment of notable events.

examples.text: He teaches Latin American history at the university and publishes books about the Cold War.

History and experience act as a filter that can distort as much as elucidate. It is largely forgotten now, overlooked in the one-line description of Tony Blair and George W Bush as the men who lied about Iraq's weapons of mass destruction, but there was a wider context to their conviction.

glosses: The portion of the past that is known and recorded by this field of study, as opposed to all earlier and unknown times that preceded it (prehistory).

examples.text: in all of human history and prehistory

glosses: A set of events involving an entity.

examples.text: a long and sordid history
What is your medical history?

glosses: A record or narrative description of past events.

examples.text: a short history of post-Columbian colonization
Thucydides wrote a history of the Peleponnesian War that uses different sources than Herodotus' work.

glosses: A list of past and continuing medical conditions of an individual or family.

examples.text: A personal medical history is required for the insurance policy.
He has a history of cancer in his family.
This diagnosis is usually based solely on the history and physical examination, although laboratory tests are occasionally also obtained.

glosses: A record of previous user events, especially of visited web pages in a browser.

examples.text: I visited a great site yesterday but forgot the URL. Luckily, I didn't clear my history.
When you do that, the browser window has no browser history, so it doesn't report a referrer page to the first site you visit.

glosses: Something that no longer exists or is no longer relevant.

examples.text: I told him that if he doesn't get his act together, he's history.

glosses: Shared experience or interaction.

examples.text: There is too much history between them for them to split up now.

glosses: A historically significant event.

examples.text: You are witnessing history!
